title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 20: wine the mocker, honest weights, and the sluggard who will not plow.

questions.text: What does the first verse of this chapter call wine?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:1 says wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler, and whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

questions.text: According to this chapter, what is it an honor for a man to do?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:3 says it is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

questions.text: Why will the sluggard beg in harvest and have nothing?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:4 says the sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

answers.text: Because his field is full of thorns
Because he will not plow by reason of the winter

questions.text: What question does this chapter ask about a man's own purity?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:9 asks, "Who can say, 'I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin?'"

answers.text: Who can know the heart of a king?
Who can say, 'I have made my heart pure'?
Who can wash his hands in innocence?
Who can cleanse himself from a hidden fault?

questions.text: What does this chapter say about differing weights and differing measures?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:10 says differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

answers.text: They are common in the market
They are an abomination to Yahweh

questions.text: How does even a child make himself known, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:11 says even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure and whether it is right.

questions.text: What does the buyer say, according to this chapter, before he goes his way and boasts?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:14 says "It's no good, it's no good," says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

questions.text: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but what happens afterwards?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:17 says fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

answers.text: His mouth is filled with gravel
His lamp is put out in darkness

questions.text: Instead of saying "I will pay back evil," what should you do according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:22 says don't say, "I will pay back evil." Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.

answers.text: Flee to a strong city for refuge
Forget the offense of your brother
Bring the matter before the judges
Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you

questions.text: According to this chapter, what is the glory of young men?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 20:29 says the glory of young men is their strength, and the splendor of old men is their gray hair.
